items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Buddy Petit had a style similar to Lil Armstrong, see.

ctx.x: Do you remember Bunk style enough? Was Buddy Petit anything like Bunk style?

No, I don't think. I don't think it all was. I just think it was a musician, a rhythm musician, trying to make a chance. No. I think Bunk had a rhythm style of his own. You take Buddy Petit, he had his style, you know. Buddy Petit had a style similar to Lil Armstrong, see. Only he couldn't play all those high notes, you know. Kid Rainey was a nice, keen tone trumpet. He played high, you know. He played like that all the time. He used to practice things with the melody below and he played above the stage, you…
Well, as I change the subject while I think of it, across the lake I'm wondering about the music there, since most people over here don't know it. Do you remember Isidore Fritz?
